Waiting on the project owner, as the build board last recorded them

  • CPA countersignature on Decision 1 — until then remittance approval rightly refuses.
  • Five missing documents: Endowment Fund Policy Statement · 2015 Scholarship Fund Policy Statement · ARFECF determination letter · Board Rules & Regulations · clean ARFECF 2013 text + ARFHSN trustee roster.
  • ~~The R6 document (who may act for a minor).~~ CLOSED 8 Sep 2026. AFRP-Portal/docs/design/AFRP-R6-Minor-Authority.md is on disk and ratified as drafted, without amendment, by the Membership Committee, Camp Ramallah and the Legal Advisor; the rules register grades R6 attested. Household authority, family event registration and camp's minor-authority surfaces are ordinary build work — slice 2b — and the refusals that stood for want of it lift. No provisional labels: this is a rule now, not a proposal.
  • Decision 5 (the two 9.1.3 drafts) — genuinely open.
  • The grace parameter (90 days proposed) and directory grace.
  • Credentials: an Authorize.Net account; an email provider (Postmark / SES / Resend).
  • The public site is built; launching it is not. The site and its admin desk shipped 6–7 Sep (33 pages from afrp.org with their sources, the Website desk under site:edit, the design layer) — Q1 of docs/QUESTIONS-FOR-DAVID.md is delivered and needs no phase. What remains is the project owner's: DNS pointed at it, a content review of the 33 seeded pages (they are afrp.org's own text, fetched, with every living person stripped — so the site currently names nobody), and entering the real Executive Committee on the People registry with their grants, since the page renders from grants and seeds no names (Q2). The four remaining programme pages are slice 6's, not a blocker.
  • Staging lifecycle: the free Render Postgres expires on its fixed window and has no backups — decide upgrade-vs-recreate before it lapses; fixture reloads run from the project owner's laptop per docs/DEPLOYING.md.
